commit_message:
Merge PR #46: read-only course module progress

Expose the same Canvas-declared module checklist through Python, CLI and MCP. Preserve normalized-reader boundaries, original owner source and exact independent receiving evidence.

Qualified synthetic merge bf654b0ae57536beb154b50693ae336d749c5324, tree 7c1bd0a858a3fda82a4d5e69076801ae65a73ea1: CI37774930260 passes lint and all 414 tests on Python 3.12. Current-parent source preservation and the complete 435-leaf native publication are independently read back.
